about: Top 5 GTA 6 Easter eggs, our countdown and our real-world context: Michael's GTA 5 boat at Jason's place (GPS still shows Los Santos), a jet-ski dog that rescues you at sea, a copy of Brian's green car from The Fast and the Furious (2001) with a HAD YOU plate, Trinity Apartments (Trinity was Dexter's season-4 villain, 2009), and a literal Easter egg in a nest on Vice City's tallest tower; Atari coined the term in 1980, and the last line loops into the hook. Commentary mode (SAFE-EDIT rule 10): five muted @blockay TikTok clips (posted 2026-11-20), his facecam, labels and captions cropped out, credit in the description only. Delta.
